summary: Consolidate photo-VQL blocked-gate persistence in focus_edit

delivery.outcome: Remove the code2llm `Shotgun Surgery: blocked` finding (planfile PLF-043) by consolidating the repeated blocked-gate persistence stanza in src/koru/integrations/vdisplay/focus_edit.py. On origin/main the smell lives in focus_edit.py (the ticket-236 split moved the gates verbatim out of vdisplay_client.py): the `active_session_dir()/persist_autonomy_phase` persist-and-return stanza is repeated inline in _photo_vql_stale_metadata_gate, _photo_vql_capture_mismatch_gate, _photo_vql_map_source_preflight_gate, _photo_vql_target_map_mismatch_gate and _photo_vql_unverified_chat_gate, and the `blocked` local is assigned in 5 functions (detector threshold: >=5 per file). Add one module-local helper _persist_blocked_gate_result(blocked, *, phase, event) that owns the persist stanza (via the late-binding _vdc() facade, preserving the facade-level monkeypatch surface) and route the five gates through it, removing the per-gate `blocked`/`err` locals; re-export the helper from the vdisplay_client facade as the ticket-236 module-split contract requires for every focus_edit def. After the change `blocked` is assigned in 2 focus_edit.py functions (_photo_vql_selected_target, _photo_vql_refined_plan) — under the >=5 threshold — and changing how blocked payloads are persisted touches one function instead of five. Add tests/test_photo_vql_blocked_gates.py pinning the phase/event wiring of every gate and the no-session path. Behavior, log text, abort payload shapes and event names are unchanged.
nonGoals: Changing any gate predicate, abort payload shape, log line, phase/event name or default flag
Renaming or moving any gate function; the only facade change is importing the new helper for the split contract (no existing name or __all__ entry changes)
Touching the send-chat `blocked` flow in vdisplay/chat_send.py (single-function file grouping, under the detector threshold)
Refactoring other code2llm findings (scan.py, mcp_provision.py, etc.)

architecture.decision: Keep the gates in focus_edit.py and extract only the duplicated persist-and-return tail into a module-local helper _persist_blocked_gate_result. The helper resolves _autonomy_session through the lazy _vdc() facade at call time, exactly like the inline stanzas it replaces, so tests that monkeypatch vdisplay_client._autonomy_session attributes keep steering every gate. The helper is re-exported from the vdisplay_client facade because tests/test_vdisplay_module_split.py pins that every def of a responsibility module is re-exported.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit to restore the inline persist stanzas in the five gates.

commands: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_photo_vql_blocked_gates.py tests/test_photo_vql_orchestrator.py tests/test_photo_vql_drive.py tests/test_photo_vql_guard_vision.py tests/test_photo_vql_monitor_source.py tests/test_vdisplay_module_split.py
validation.evidence: All photo-VQL/vdisplay tests pass unchanged, including the facade-level monkeypatch surface and the ticket-236 module-split pins (focus_edit stays under the 40-def god-module gate: 28 -> 29 defs).
The `blocked` local is assigned in fewer than 5 functions of focus_edit.py (code2llm shotgun-surgery threshold is >=5 mutations of one variable per file).
No new ruff findings on the touched files.
